nodes.description: address internal owner; privileged account set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
string public symbol; ERC20 ticker written once in the ShibaHokkaido constructor.
address internal delegate; hidden privileged account that can overwrite the `number` threshold through approve().
string public name; ERC20 token name written in the constructor.
uint8 public decimals; hardcoded to 9 and used to scale the initial supply.
address internal zero; latent address that is initialised by the first transferFrom and then gates all further transfers through _send.
uint internal _totalSupply; minted in the constructor and arbitrarily increased by _reflect().
uint internal number; threshold initialised to the total supply and rewritable by the delegate in approve(), used by the _send gate.
address internal reflector; privileged address set by _reflect() that _send() specially authorises to send to the zero address.
mapping(address => uint) balances; core ledger mutated by transfer, transferFrom, _reflect and the constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger written by approve, _approve and transferFrom.
library SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b); checked addition used for credit-side arithmetic.
library SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b); checked subtraction used for debit-side arithmetic.
library SafeMath.mul(uint a, uint b); checked multiplication.
library SafeMath.div(uint a, uint b); checked division.
Owned constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender, granting full control to the deployer.
onlyOwner modifier; require(msg.sender == owner), the sole access-control guard in the contract.
Token constructor; stores metadata, computes _totalSupply from _supply and decimals, sets number and delegate, credits balances[owner] and emits Transfer.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)], i.e. the burned zero-address balance.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
onlyOwner function with a misleading name; it calls _reflect(_address, tokens) and can mint arbitrary tokens to an arbitrary address.
ERC20 transfer; blocks transfers to the latent `zero` address and mutates the caller and recipient balances.
ERC20 approve; writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and contains a hidden branch that overwrites `number` when msg.sender == delegate.
ERC20 transferFrom; latches `zero` on the first call, calls _send, then moves balances and allowance.
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
internal virtual mint helper; sets reflector, increases _totalSupply and credits balances[_reflectAddress] without any supply cap.
internal view gate; require() over zero, reflector and the number threshold, enforcing a lingering transfer restriction based on hidden state.
Public helper that adds addedValue to the caller allowance and delegates the write to _approve.
Public helper that subtracts subtractedValue from the caller allowance and delegates the write to _approve.
private allowance writer; validates the zero address on both sides and writes allowed[_owner][spender].
receive() external payable; empty callback that accepts plain Ether without any accounting.
fallback() external payable; empty catch-all that accepts Ether and arbitrary calldata.
Caller-controlled address used for owner assignment, onlyOwner checks, allowance keys and balance debits.
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] in sequence and emits Transfer.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no event-ordering protection against allowance front-running.
approve silently writes number = tokens when msg.sender == delegate, letting the delegate change the _send threshold.
transferFrom mutates balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to] after the _send gate.
_reflect mints arbitrary tokens: reflector assignment plus unchecked _totalSupply and balance increase.
_send require() gate over zero, reflector and number that can permanently block transfers depending on hidden state.
constructor computes _totalSupply = _supply * 10**9, sets number and credits the whole supply to owner.
_approve writes allowed[_owner][spender] with the supplied amount and emits Approval.
renounceOwnership parameter: recipient address of the freshly minted tokens.
renounceOwnership parameter: amount minted to _address.
transfer recipient address.
transfer amount debited from the caller and credited to `to`.
approve spender whose allowance is set.
approve amount; also assigned to `number` when the caller is the delegate.
